events.summary: Lightscape, An Immersive Non-Linear Film by Doug Aitken. 65min. Not Rated. Presented as part of PAM CUT’s PLUS PLUS Festival, Lightscape – a new film-based installation by artist Doug Aitken and produced with the LA Phil and LA Master Chorale – considers our landscape of diversity, creating a vulnerable and humanistic portrait that chronicles the search to find one’s individuality in a world of continuous transformation. Lightscape takes immersive cinema to an extreme, and moves like a fast-paced fever dream through the modern world. It follows multiple characters in an Altman-esque structure, taking us on a journey that explores a landscape in the midst of our rapidly changing world—from the deep ecology of Death Valley’s deserts and dramatic mountainscapes to futuristic robotics factories and environments reinterpreted through the digital realm. The audio in Lightscape features Gustavo Dudamel, one of the world’s premiere conductors, who conducts original music for the film with the LA Philharmonic of iconic minimalist composers and artists such as Philip Glass, Steve Reich, Meredith Monk and original scores by Beck & LA LOM, and Doug Aitken. The diverse cast of Lightscape mirrors the landscapes its characters occupy. Natasha Lyonne is seen in a nocturnal high-rise in an existential sequence. Urban crump dancers move through automated factories, their bodies driving and twitching in response to their mechanized surroundings. A migrant worker speeds through the desert at escape velocity. Lightscape creates a vulnerable and humanistic portrait that chronicles the search to find one’s individuality in a world of continuous rapid transformation. We are thrust into seemingly disparate worlds, with each character on a different journey, but as the narrative progresses, the stories interconnect. Lightscape is a visual poem. Lightscape is for our times and about our times. Like a fragmented mirror, the film is immersive—we fall into it, and follow the different characters who converge to create a worldview: one of connectivity, struggle, hope, and exploring what our future may bring. We do not generally provide advisories about subject matter or potentially triggering content in films, and films exhibited don’t necessarily reflect the views of PAM CUT or the Portland Art Museum. In addition to the synopses, trailers, and other links on our website, further information about content and age-appropriateness for specific films can be found on sites like Common Sense Media, IMDb, and DoesTheDogDie.com.

events.summary: Run Time: 125 min. Doors 2:30 p.m.; Event 3 p.m.; Q&A following the film. Select Showtime to Purchase Tickets Click here to learn more about accessibility at the Tomorrow Theater. Join us for a special screening of March Forth, a film about the poet, author, lawyer, activist, and 2021 MacArthur Fellow Reginald Dwayne Betts. Following the screening, there will be a moderated conversation with Reginald Dwayne Betts, Robe Imbriano (Director & Executive Producer), and Thomas Curtis (Production Designer & Animator). March Forth Is a Beautifully Told Odyssey of Reginald Dwayne Bettss Life After Prison. Black Girl Nerds March Forth (narrated by Oscar nominee Brian Tyree Henry) conveys how powerful literacy and connection are, and how critical it is for the men and women locked up to not feel like theyve been abandoned. Honeysuckle Magazine This screening is part of our Plus Plus Festival. Check out the full program here! The Partnership for Safety and Justice will also be on hand tabling prior and after the event. 2026. Directed by Robe Imbriano and Valerie Hong. Runtime: 1 hour 35 minutes. Reginald Dwayne Betts went to adult prison at 16 and survived to write about it. March Forth is an intimate exploration into the life and thoughts of this acclaimed poet, author, lawyer, activist, and MacArthur Genius Award winner. Betts served almost nine years for carjacking, and before becoming an adult bore witness to the cruelties of the American legal system. In prison he named himself, Shahid, meaning witness in Arabic. In solitary confinement, he became a poet. After his release on March 4th, 2005, Betts was determined to march forth into the world and leave prison behind. He began teaching, publishing multiple award-winning collections of poetry, a memoir, and even graduating from Yale Law School. As an attorney, hes secured the release of men he served time with. But instead of leaving prison behind, in 2020, he created Freedom Reads, a non-profit that places libraries he curates in prison cell blocks across America. The return has been complicated. Going back means remembering who is left behind and more painfully, those hes failed to get free. March Forth offers an intimate look into how he carries the two realities he moves through; one of immeasurable success and contribution and accolades and one of guilt and persistent doubt of his own self-worth. Through live performance, animation, poetry, and memoir excerpts narrated by Brian Tyree Henry, March Forth explores the lasting impact of serving time in adult prison as a teenager. Reginald Dwayne Betts received a BA (2009) from the University of Maryland, an MFA (2010) from Warren Wilson College, and a JD (2016) from Yale Law School. He is currently a PhD candidate in law at Yale Law School. Betts was appointed by President Barack Obama to the Coordinating Council of the Office of Juvenile Justice and Delinquency Prevention in 2012, and since 2018 he has served as a member of Connecticuts Criminal Justice Commission, which appoints state prosecutors. His additional publications include the poetry collections Bastards of the Reagan Era (2015) and Shahid Reads His Own Palm (2010) and the memoir Question of Freedom: A Memoir of Learning, Survival, and Coming of Age in Prison (2009). Robe Imbriano is an award-winning director and showrunner. His animated musical documentary about the injustice of cash bail, Criminal, animated by Thomas Curtis with music and lyrics by Stew Stewart and Heidi Rodewald and published by The New Yorker, won Best Animated Short at the UrbanWorld Film Festival. He was the showrunner of the Hulu series, Killing County, with Colin Kaepernick. Imbriano co-created and Executive Produced the Netflix documentary series Amend, starring Will Smith and featuring Mahershala Ali, Samuel L. Jackson, Sherrilyn Ifill, and Bryan Stevenson, to tell the story of the 14th Amendment and Americas struggle with equality. He was a showrunner of the launch of Soul of a Nation, the very first major broadcast network series about Black life in America, nominated for 11 Emmy Awards in its very first season. Imbriano has written and produced for everyone from Diane Sawyer and Peter Jennings to Bill Moyers and Oprah Winfrey, winning numerous honors along the way. He currently runs the Documentary Specialization at the Columbia Journalism School. Thomas Curtis won a Cinema Eye award for his work on Going to Mars: the Nikki Giovanni Project, seen on Max and shown at Sundance. He is a Motion Graphics artist and animator whose work ranges from the Annenberg Foundations Constitution Project films, Right to Offend: The Black Comedy Revolution for A&E, CNNs New Orleans: Soul of a City , and Amend for Netflix. Recent projects include creating the design and animation for Criminal, a New Yorker Documentary about the harrowing conditions in the Harris County Jail.
events.title: March Forth w/ Reginald Dwayne Betts, Robe Imbriano, Thomas Curtis

events.summary: In Buddhist thought, the Tree of Life is a symbol of awakening, wisdom, and the interconnectedness of all life. Its roots reach deep into the earth while its branches extend toward the sky, reminding us that each generation grows from those that came before and that our lives are shaped by the communities and traditions that sustain us. Opening the PSU Choirs' concert season, "Tree of Life" explores these themes through music that spans continents and centuries. Performed by the PSU Chamber Choir, Rose Choir and Thorn Choir, the program pairs cherished works from the Classical choral tradition with music by a new generation of Southeast Asian composers. At its center is Indonesian composer Bagus Utomo's Gayatri, inspired by the legendary queen whose wisdom and spiritual devotion remain an enduring part of Indonesian cultural heritage. The concert also features works by Budi Susanto Yohanes, Ily Matthew Maniano and Matthew Lyon Hazzard. Several of these pieces will be recorded later this year by the internationally acclaimed PSU Chamber Choir at Skywalker Sound, offering audiences an opportunity to hear this music before it is released. This concert will be performed twice: Friday, November 20 at 7:30 PM and November 22 at 4:00 PM. View the full 2026-2027 Choir Season, Tree of Life. Learn more about the Portland State University School of Music & Theater Choirs.

What happens when mid-century urban cool meets the organic sustain of a steel-string acoustic? Join us for an evening of late-1950s Miles Davis tunes re-envisioned for acoustic guitar, upright bass, and drums. Stripped-back, atmospheric, and deeply dynamic. Pacific Northwest acoustic guitarist Eric Skye occupies a unique niche between jazz and folk. He has always had a bit of a connection to the music of Miles Davis, particularly the seminal modal jazz album, Kind Of Blue and that era. In fact, in 2012 he released his acclaimed album, “A Different Kind Of Blue,” which was a solo acoustic guitar album reimagining of “Kind Of Blue, recorded all in one sitting with improvisational approach as opposed to planned arrangements. Eric Has released nine albums in total. Including other solo acoustic jazz/blues records like 2018’s Ballads and Blues, 2004’s For Lulu, Acoustic Jazz Guitar Solos from 2000.. Or the contemporary improvisational duo album, Artifact, from 2015 with longtime Jackson Browne guitarist, Mark Goldenberg. There’s also several albums of adventuresome improvisation takes on American old-time fiddle tunes with mandolin virtuoso Tim Connell (June Apple 2015) and guitarist Jamie Stillway (Home On The Midrange in 2021, and Over The Waterfall in 2023). It’s a wide-ranging body of work, all threaded together with a minimalist’s aesthetic, a passion for in-the-moment music making, and a love of pure acoustic tone. “Tone, taste, and technique” -JAZZIZ magazine GENERAL ADMISSION AND FULLY SEATED. events.summary: Tickets go on sale to Hollywood Theatre Members on Wednesday 10/21 at noon, and to the general public on Thursday 10/22 at noon.In the winter of 1963, the most epic comedy ever made had its Pacific Northwest premiere in Cinerama right here at the Hollywood Theatre, where it ran for a record 44 weeks. Now, for one night only and for the first time in more than sixty years, IT’S A MAD, MAD, MAD, MAD WORLD returns to the Hollywood in wide, wide, wide, wide 70mm Ultra Panavision! They don’t make them like this anymore. A cast of basically every comedian alive at the time, plus cameos from comedy legends past and future. A near-three-hour runtime that isn’t a minute too long, with an overture and an intermission. Old-school stunts and spectacular wreckage, captured on a scale no studio would bankroll today. When a dying crook tells a group of strangers that $350,000 is buried under “the Big W,” the race is on. Ordinary, seemingly decent people lie, cheat, crash, and blow up everything in their path across Southern California to get to the money first. Producer-director Stanley Kramer spent his career using popular movies to make audiences face the country’s hardest truths. So when he set out to make the comedy to end all comedies, Kramer did what he did best, only this time for laughs. Relentlessly funny and gloriously unhinged, IT’S A MAD, MAD, MAD, MAD WORLD is the film that inspired Comedy 101, the Hollywood Theatre’s signature series on foundational and iconic comedy films. Limited edition MAD WORLD posters will be for sale in the lobby after the show, along with posters from select past Comedy 101 featured films. Run time: 202 mins Format: 70mm
events.title: IT’S A MAD MAD MAD MAD WORLD in 70mm

events.summary: The winner of the 2024 Tony Award® for Best Musical is THE OUTSIDERS. Adapted from S.E. HINTON’s seminal novel and FRANCIS FORD COPPOLA’s iconic film, this thrilling new musical features a book by ADAM RAPP with JUSTIN LEVINE, music and lyrics by JAMESTOWN REVIVAL (Jonathan Clay & Zach Chance) and JUSTIN LEVINE, music supervision, orchestration, and arrangements by JUSTIN LEVINE, choreography by RICK KUPERMAN & JEFF KUPERMAN, and direction by Tony Award® winner DANYA TAYMOR. Entertainment Weekly says, "It has the power to inspire an entire generation." In Tulsa, Oklahoma, 1967, Ponyboy Curtis, his best friend Johnny Cade and their Greaser family of ‘outsiders’ battle with their affluent rivals, the Socs. THE OUTSIDERS navigates the complexities of self-discovery as the Greasers dream about who they want to become in a world that may never accept them. With a dynamic original score, THE OUTSIDERS is a story of friendship, family, belongingand the realization that there is still “lots of good in the world.”

events.summary: Before he embarked on a roaring rampage of revenge with 1977's Rolling Thunder, director John Flynn made The Outfit, a hard-boiled thriller par excellence, based on a novel by Richard Stark (aka Donald E. The entire criminal underworld is about to learn an unforgettable lesson: never mess with Earl Macklin.

events.summary: Shafty returns to The Get Down for their annual 2-night Thansgiving week run! Tuesday, November 24 Doors: 7:00 PM | Show: 8:00 PM Wednesday, November 25 Doors: 7:00 PM | Show: 8:00 PM What began as essentially a goof – a chance to throw down some familiar dancy beats and jam for whoever felt like listening - ultimately lit a spark under the off-the-radar powder keg of Phish fans in the Portland, Oregon music scene. More time was spent talking about the possibility of putting a Phish tribute together than actually practicing, prior to their first performance at local basement pub The Goodfoot Lounge, in February of 2012. Expectations for attendance were moderate at best, yet before the band played the first note, there was a line out the door, culminating in a jam-filled celebration of the music of Phish to an over-capacity crowd! The demand for a repeat was high, and Shafty was born. If there's a motive, it's to recreate the energy of a Phish show, with the attitude of playful band-audience interaction at the forefront and sharp musical skill acting as a behind-the-scenes glue to hold it all together. Classic Phish gimmicks are in full force: trampolines, megaphones, choreographed dances, vacuum cleaner solos, instrument switching, and the secret language are alive and well at a Shafty show. The band's songlist evolves along side Phish's growing catalog. Now at over 300 songs performed, the repertoire includes brand new Phish material such as Turtle in the Clouds, Say it to Me SANTOS, Mercury, The Howling and more! A notable "Story of the Ghostbusters" mashup made news on JamBase.com, and the usual hijinks of slicing, dicing, and unpredictably rearranging songs continues. It is not uncommon for the band to perform weeklies at The Goodfoot Lounge, where they'll perform for weeks on end without repeating a single Phish tune, thus providing a fresh concert experience for the diehards who attend week by week, while adding new material. These weeklies have helped create the telepathic musical chemistry between the band members, as well as providing the motivation to learn as many songs as possible to please the fanbase.
events.title: Shafty: Portland's Tribute to Phish (2 Nights

A SUMPTUOUS VINTAGE-INSPIRED MUSICAL EXPERIENCE Postmodern Jukebox — the internationally acclaimed music collective famed for their signature time-twisting style, transforming some of our most loved songs into dazzling vintage masterpieces — has announced a brand-new 56 date trek titled The Future is Vintage Tour. The tour kicks off in Finland on April 17th and travels through mainland Europe and the UK before heading to Australia & New Zealand in June. Renowned for their joyous, high-energy live shows, the multi-talented troupe of singers, dancers and instrumentalists will bring a brand new production to stages across the country — putting a retro spin on everything from ’70s rock classics and ’80s Britpop staples to today’s chart-toppers, movie themes and even video-game soundtracks. Packed with dance-ready numbers and jaw-dropping showstoppers, it’s a show that works just as well for a big night out as it does for the perfect family outing. Founded in New York by pianist and arranger Scott Bradlee in 2011, Postmodern Jukebox began as a series of videos recorded in a small apartment, transforming contemporary pop songs into vintage jazz, swing, and soul arrangements. What started as a YouTube sensation has since evolved into a global touring phenomenon, with sold-out shows on six continents and over a billion online views. The rotating cast has featured some of the most remarkable vocalists, musicians and performers working today — artists whose charisma, stagecraft and extraordinary musicality have made Postmodern Jukebox shows unlike anything else on the touring circuit. For more than a decade, fans around the world have flocked to these concerts not just for the music, but for the pure theatrical thrill: a meticulously crafted night of escapism, humour, virtuosity, and irresistible fun. Speaking about the upcoming tour, Bradlee said: "In the midst of the AI hype all around us, some folks have gone so far as to proclaim that in the not-so-distant future, all of the music that we listen to will be AI generated... we’ll gladly take the other side of that wager. On the 2026 Postmodern Jukebox North American tour, we're humbly presenting our own unique vision of a spectacular future; one that is built upon the timeless musical genres of the past and the authentically human spirit of creativity that inspired them." Fans are encouraged to dress in their vintage best and step into the immersive world of Postmodern Jukebox for a night of musical time travel — a feel-good celebration that honours the past, energises the present, and champions a brilliantly human future for music. events.summary: Bria Damage, fronted by Angelo Bria - proof that surviving the Sunset Strip in the '80s builds either character... or a bad credit score. After decades of touring, Angelo relocated to the Pacific Northwest, where he joined Earth To Ashes as bassist and co-vocalist, being the chief lyricist for the first two releases, Cursed Invoked and their self-titled follow up. In 2022, BRIA released Target Audience, followed by the 2023 single Stop Quality, Then in 2026, BRIA unleashed Optimus Masochist, the first single from their five-song EP produced by Dead End Bowie. The song blends classic Sunset Strip swagger with enough sarcasm to make the internet uncomfortable. Channeling the spirit of David Lee Roth after three energy drinks and a midlife crisis, BRIA walks the fine line between ridiculous and brilliant - usually in leather pants.

events.summary: Rhys Darby is an actor, writer, podcaster and stand-up comedian from New Zealand. Darby first captured US audiences as Murray, the loveable, but ultimately inept manager in HBO’s Flight of the Conchords. He has gone on to star in a plethora of TV and film roles, from Yes Man and Pirate Radio (The Boat that Rocked) to Nigel in the Jumanji reboots. On the small screen he has brought his talents to animations like Voltron Legendary Defender and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, and shows like TBS’ Wrecked, The X Files and Lemony Snicket. Most recently he starred as the gentleman pirate, Stede Bonnet in Our Flag Means Death. Darby is never far from his stand-up roots. His stand-up has been described as a sensational blend of sound effects, characterizations and askew observations. Rhys has five stand-up specials’, Imagine That! (2008), It’s Rhys Darby Night! (2011) and This Way to Spaceship, (2012) and I’m a Fighter Jet (2017) and Mystic Time Bird (2021). This Way to Spaceship was based on his debut novel of the same name, “A loosely autobiographical end of world companion” in 2012. It was number 1 in the international charts for 7 weeks. Darby’s second book, this time for kids, was released in Australia and New Zealand in October 2018. It is called The Top Secret Notes of Buttons McGinty. Darby wrote it for his then 8-year-old son, a reluctant reader, and has been thrilled to hear from kids and parents that they love it! He went on to release another two Buttons books, which thrilled his legions of junior fans. Rhys’ love of the weird is seen in his stand-up and writing, and for ten years he has had first a radio show, then a podcast on cryptozoology, The Cryptid Factor. Darby was thrilled when approached by Spotify to do a podcast about aliens, Aliens like Us. A regular attendee of alien conferences and stargazer, it was a dream come true. A prolific voice-over artist, kids all over the world hear him in Voltron: Legendary defender, Spirit, TMNT, Boss Baby, Jake and the Neverland Pirates and many more. He also lends his voice to animated films like Trolls, Teen Titans Go, 100% Wolf and Mosley. Darby is excited to lend his voice to the upcoming film That Christmas and the classic story, Badjelly the Witch. In between his huge adventures Darby is based in Los Angeles with his family where they like to hike, eat tacos and explore the world. events.summary: LizaBanks Campagna is building an entirely new lane in the creator economy, one where comedy, culture, and civic curiosity collide. In 2025, she emerged as one of the most original voices reshaping how audiences engage with cities, institutions, and public life, proving that education and entertainment do not just coexist, they thrive together. A stand-up comedian, LizaBanks has applied her comedic instincts to an unexpected arena, tourism and cultural education. As a New York City tour guide leading sold out experiences at The Metropolitan Museum of Art and Grand Central Terminal, she has transformed traditional sightseeing into immersive, personality driven storytelling. Her tours feel less like lectures and more like live performances, attracting audiences who may never have stepped inside a museum otherwise. In the process, she is modernizing tourism for a social first generation and demonstrating how creators can bring legacy institutions into the digital age. Online, LizaBanks extends that same sensibility through content that blends humor, historical context, and sharp social observation. In 2025, she expanded her platform into civic conversation, interviewing political figures including Zohran Mamdani and engaging audiences around issues like public transit and accessibility with clarity and curiosity. She frequently collaborates with Overheard, including hosting its Happy Hour series, and facilitating red carpet interviews. An Undying Love For A Burning World is the first new release from Neurosis in a decade, and a potent statement of intent and rebirth - one that marks the first new steps of resolve and resilience. “We need this, perhaps more than ever, and we suspect we are not alone. The trials and tribulations in our personal lives and as a band, combined with simply trying to navigate the insanity of our society, with the stress, anxiety, and isolation that come with it can be excruciating. Add to that the existential confusion and sorrow of the climate crisis and the sixth mass extinction. It is enough to cause you to completely lose your mind if you can’t find release or catharsis. This strange emotionally charged music has always been our method of trying to survive this and this is what we've always been singing about. When you have spent a lifetime engaged with these energies and utilizing this form of expression to purge and purify, it feels detrimental to our well being to let it sit idle and neglected. This was now or never.” An Undying Love For A Burning World is an epic album of colossal hypnotism - beautiful, fearsome and utterly compelling in a way that only Neurosis can be. Aaron Turner (Sumac, Isis) joins the band on vocals and guitar, a name whose legacy is intertwined with the band’s own and a true kindred spirit. “He came straight out of the gate contributing, writing and presenting ideas,” says the band. “His energy matches ours perfectly. It’s as if he was always meant to be there.” Aaron adds, “From the moment I first heard Neurosis over 30 years ago, I felt this was the music my heart and mind had been seeking but not yet heard. Now after many years travelling along various musical paths of my own, the singular sound and spirit embodied by Neurosis continues to speak to the depths of my being. It is an honor and a true pleasure to have been welcomed so warmly into a band that not only shaped my perspective on the limitless possibilities of music - but has lived and exemplified the necessity of upholding creative integrity and camaraderie above all else.” Neurosis have never been afraid of change, and here they embrace endless regeneration, surrendering to the emotional exorcism through heaviness and distortion that their music incites. Just as the universe tends towards balance, Neurosis’cacophony of noise, rhythm and dissonance always resolves towards moments of beauty. The addition of Turner's powerful vocals and wildly creative and unhinged approach to guitar proves to be a vital force as Neurosis find themselves again at the mercy of evolution and expression. The album was recorded by Scott Evans (Kowloon Walled City, Sumac, and Great Falls) at Studio Litho in Seattle during three weekends this winter, and mixed in three days just six weeks before release at Evan's Antisleep Audio in Oakland. events.summary: This will be a special night for all dance lovers! Come at 8PM and get a Forró Dance class! Josephina Del Norte: The Argentinian DJ, singer and multi-instrumentalist Josefina Del Norte will start the night playing a mix of Latin American Cumbia and Forró music from Brazil. Forró Beleza: Led by Pyata Penedo, a Brazilian lead singer, composer, multi-instrumentalist, and owner of Figure 8 Sound Recording Studio, the band performs a variety of music from Northeastern Brazil known as forró. Forró is a lively Brazilian music and partner-dance tradition rooted in Northeastern Brazil, where it developed through community gatherings centered around music, dancing, and social connection. Popularized nationally by legendary artists such as Luiz Gonzaga, its distinctive sound is traditionally created by the accordion, zabumba drum, and triangle, producing rhythms that feel both grounded and flowing. The dance brings people together through a warm embrace, shared movement, playful turns, and a close connection to the music. Although it may remind newcomers of the intimacy of tango, the energy of salsa, or the grounded feeling of blues, forró has a joyful and welcoming character entirely its own. More than simply a style of music or dance, forró is a celebration of Brazilian culture and community—and the best way to understand it is to come experience it for yourself!
events.title: Forró Beleza

Take a break and treat yourself after a long Turkey Day and join us for Portland's wildest and most interactive comedy and storytelling entertainment event: the annual Best Of Pants On Fire! Party at the historic White Eagle Hotel & Saloon. Each Pants On Fire! show features eight of the Northwest's premier storytellers, comedians, artists, writers, celebrities & musicians telling some of the most outrageous, hard-to-believe, 100% true stories you've ever heard - except that one of our storytellers will be lying to your face, telling a complete whopper that never happened. events.summary: Rhys Darby is an actor, writer, podcaster and stand-up comedian from New Zealand. Darby first captured US audiences as Murray, the loveable, but ultimately inept manager in HBO’s Flight of the Conchords. He has gone on to star in a plethora of TV and film roles, from Yes Man and Pirate Radio (The Boat that Rocked) to Nigel in the Jumanji reboots. On the small screen he has brought his talents to animations like Voltron Legendary Defender and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, and shows like TBS’ Wrecked, The X Files and Lemony Snicket. Most recently he starred as the gentleman pirate, Stede Bonnet in Our Flag Means Death. Darby is never far from his stand-up roots. His stand-up has been described as a sensational blend of sound effects, characterizations and askew observations. Rhys has five stand-up specials’, Imagine That! (2008), It’s Rhys Darby Night! (2011) and This Way to Spaceship, (2012) and I’m a Fighter Jet (2017) and Mystic Time Bird (2021). This Way to Spaceship was based on his debut novel of the same name, “A loosely autobiographical end of world companion” in 2012. It was number 1 in the international charts for 7 weeks. Darby’s second book, this time for kids, was released in Australia and New Zealand in October 2018. It is called The Top Secret Notes of Buttons McGinty. Darby wrote it for his then 8-year-old son, a reluctant reader, and has been thrilled to hear from kids and parents that they love it! He went on to release another two Buttons books, which thrilled his legions of junior fans. Rhys’ love of the weird is seen in his stand-up and writing, and for ten years he has had first a radio show, then a podcast on cryptozoology, The Cryptid Factor. Darby was thrilled when approached by Spotify to do a podcast about aliens, Aliens like Us. A regular attendee of alien conferences and stargazer, it was a dream come true. A prolific voice-over artist, kids all over the world hear him in Voltron: Legendary defender, Spirit, TMNT, Boss Baby, Jake and the Neverland Pirates and many more. He also lends his voice to animated films like Trolls, Teen Titans Go, 100% Wolf and Mosley. Darby is excited to lend his voice to the upcoming film That Christmas and the classic story, Badjelly the Witch. In between his huge adventures Darby is based in Los Angeles with his family where they like to hike, eat tacos and explore the world. events.summary: LizaBanks Campagna is building an entirely new lane in the creator economy, one where comedy, culture, and civic curiosity collide. A stand-up comedian, LizaBanks has applied her comedic instincts to an unexpected arena, tourism and cultural education. As a New York City tour guide leading sold out experiences at The Metropolitan Museum of Art and Grand Central Terminal, she has transformed traditional sightseeing into immersive, personality driven storytelling. Her tours feel less like lectures and more like live performances, attracting audiences who may never have stepped inside a museum otherwise. In the process, she is modernizing tourism for a social first generation and demonstrating how creators can bring legacy institutions into the digital age. Online, LizaBanks extends that same sensibility through content that blends humor, historical context, and sharp social observation. As the pair is drawn into a conflict threatening the balance of the forest itself, Prue must discover the strength and belief she never knew she possessed. If she hopes to save her brother and protect Wildwood’s fragile future, she will have to risk everything. From Oscar®-nominated and BAFTA®-winning LAIKA, Wildwood is a sweeping adventure about love, sacrifice, and the magic that reveals itself when we dare to look beyond the familiar.

events.summary: Sketch Coven is a meetup and workshop for sketch comedians. Each month, we get together at Kickstand Comedy to read scripts in progress, give supportive feedback, and help develop a fun, vibrant sketch community here in Portland. NOTE: This meeting will take place off site at 21ten Theatre 2110 SE 10th Ave Click to sign up as a writer, actor, or just to observe and meet new people. Writers bring drafts of their work for the group, including actors and acting-curious improvisers, to table read. Facilitators will provide feedback, then open discussion. Whether you have a completed script, a rough draft, or just a loose concept you'd like to flesh out, Sketch Coven is a place to develop your sketch skills – don't be shy! We prioritize scripts from first timers and revised drafts of sketches we've read at previous meetings. Expect to only have one script read, but feel free to bring more. We'll do our best to get through as many as we can in the time we have. Every 4th Saturday of the month. Suggested donation is $10 to support this and other Kickstand programs. Payment/ticket purchase is not required to attend, but please be sure to RSVP with your info. DISCLAIMER: THIS IS NOT A SKETCH CLASS OR SHOW. While we want this to be a constructive experience for everyone, Sketch Coven doesn't teach a set curriculum. If you're looking to learn the basics of sketch writing, we recommend you take Kickstand's classes

The beloved book and score by Tony Award winners, Thomas Meehan, Charles Strouse and Martin Charnin, features some of the greatest musical theatre hits ever written, including "Tomorrow." With equal measures of pluck and positivity, little orphan Annie charms everyone's hearts despite a next-to-nothing start in 1930s New York City. She is determined to find the parents who abandoned her years ago on the doorstep of a New York City Orphanage that is run by the cruel, embittered Miss Hannigan. With the help of the other girls in the Orphanage, Annie escapes to the wondrous world of NYC. In adventure after fun-filled adventure, Annie foils Miss Hannigan's evil machinations... and even befriends President Franklin Delano Roosevelt! She finds a new home and family in billionaire, Oliver Warbucks, his personal secretary, Grace Farrell, and a lovable mutt named Sandy.

No motive, no clues, nothing to link Guy and Bruno but a casual meeting of strangers on a train. Guy laughs it off. But soon, his wife is horribly murdered. events.summary: Rhys Darby is an actor, writer, podcaster and stand-up comedian from New Zealand. Darby first captured US audiences as Murray, the loveable, but ultimately inept manager in HBO’s Flight of the Conchords. He has gone on to star in a plethora of TV and film roles, from Yes Man and Pirate Radio (The Boat that Rocked) to Nigel in the Jumanji reboots. On the small screen he has brought his talents to animations like Voltron Legendary Defender and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, and shows like TBS’ Wrecked, The X Files and Lemony Snicket. Most recently he starred as the gentleman pirate, Stede Bonnet in Our Flag Means Death. Darby is never far from his stand-up roots. His stand-up has been described as a sensational blend of sound effects, characterizations and askew observations. Rhys has five stand-up specials’, Imagine That! (2008), It’s Rhys Darby Night! (2011) and This Way to Spaceship, (2012) and I’m a Fighter Jet (2017) and Mystic Time Bird (2021). This Way to Spaceship was based on his debut novel of the same name, “A loosely autobiographical end of world companion” in 2012. It was number 1 in the international charts for 7 weeks. Darby’s second book, this time for kids, was released in Australia and New Zealand in October 2018. It is called The Top Secret Notes of Buttons McGinty. Darby wrote it for his then 8-year-old son, a reluctant reader, and has been thrilled to hear from kids and parents that they love it! He went on to release another two Buttons books, which thrilled his legions of junior fans. Rhys’ love of the weird is seen in his stand-up and writing, and for ten years he has had first a radio show, then a podcast on cryptozoology, The Cryptid Factor. Darby was thrilled when approached by Spotify to do a podcast about aliens, Aliens like Us. A regular attendee of alien conferences and stargazer, it was a dream come true. A prolific voice-over artist, kids all over the world hear him in Voltron: Legendary defender, Spirit, TMNT, Boss Baby, Jake and the Neverland Pirates and many more. He also lends his voice to animated films like Trolls, Teen Titans Go, 100% Wolf and Mosley. Darby is excited to lend his voice to the upcoming film That Christmas and the classic story, Badjelly the Witch. In between his huge adventures Darby is based in Los Angeles with his family where they like to hike, eat tacos and explore the world. events.summary: Satuday, November 18th, 2026 $18 Advance // $25 Day of 5pm Doors / 6pm Show All Ages 4th ANNUAL BAKERSFIELD BASH On Saturday, November 28th, The Countryside Ride Band will be bringing their 4th Annual Bakersfield Bash to the Trout Lake Hall celebrating their most influential country music subgenre: The Bakersfield Sound. Being West Coast country artists, Countryside Ride has been profoundly influenced by the Bakersfield Sound, the artists who created it, and are thrilled to be dedicating a night to performing the music of Buck Owens, Merle Haggard, Wynn Stewart, Red Simpson, Tommy Collins, Dwight Yoakum, and many more of the purveyors of The Bakersfield Sound. Mark your calendars and don’t forget to bring your dancing boots! “Let me tell you about The Bakersfield Sound. It was the wild untamed side of country music that came out of California’s Central Valley in the 50s and 60s. This wasn’t your polished Nashville-style country, no Sir, this was rougher, rawer, and a whole lot louder: just like the folks who made it. Buck Owens and Merle Haggard were the kings of this scene, but they weren’t alone. Wynn Stewart brought some west coast swagger, with his smooth vocals and sharp guitar work, while Tommy Collins laid the groundwork that mixed humor and heartache in a way that was pure country. Bonnie Owens, not just Merle’s wife but a powerhouse vocalist, added warmth and depth, while Red Simpson kept the highways humming with his truck driving anthems. The Bakersfield Sound was born in the honky tonks and roadhouses of Bakersfield, where the beer flowed and the dance floors stayed packed. These folks cranked up the twang on their Telecasters, slapped on a honky tonk beat, and sang about real life struggles: hard work, hard luck, and heartbreak that could only be drowned out with a stiff drink. They took the clean polished sound of Nashville and gave it a shot of adrenaline: creating music that was tough as nails and real as dirt. So, when you hear those driving rhythms, sharp guitar riffs, and honest to God lyrics, you’re hearing The Bakersfield Sound: a raw, real, and unapologetically authentic slice of country music history.” (The Bakersfield Sound) COUNTRYSIDE RIDE The Countryside Ride Band was described in 2016 by The Portland Mercury as “spot-on, honky-tonk preservationists capable of teaching a master class.” Founded in 2005 by childhood friends Bret Ervin (guitar and vocals), Joshua Kunze (lead guitar), and Jessica Renee (bass and vocals), Countryside Ride originally performed as a three-piece before inviting some of the best country & western players in the Pacific Northwest to join them. Countryside Ride is now performing primarily as a five-piece honkytonk band. For over two decades, Countryside Ride has been writing and performing original music and traditional honkytonk standards in venues throughout the region. The current line-up includes the tremendous J.D. Cunningham on pedal-steel guitar, and the legendary Kevin, “Shuffle King,” Major on drums. In the years since Countryside Ride’s inception, the band has been working to hone their craft the way their honkytonk heroes did: playing marathon sets for diehard country music enthusiasts wherever they may be. Countryside Ride can be found performing at festivals, dances, special events, venues large and small, and rodeos like the Pendleton Roundup: consistently entertaining multiple generations of music fans while breathing new energy in traditional Country music. Additionally, Countryside Ride has shared the stage with acts like Wayne “The Train” Hancock, Rosie Flores, Hellbound Glory, Summer Dean, and many others. Although they have released two of their own records (with two more in the works), Countryside Ride’s repertoire is vast and incorporates multiple sub-genres of American music as well: making them the Pacific Northwest’s premier honkytonk dance band.
events.title: Countryside Ride's 4th Annual Bakersfield Bash

events.summary: LizaBanks Campagna is building an entirely new lane in the creator economy, one where comedy, culture, and civic curiosity collide. In 2025, she emerged as one of the most original voices reshaping how audiences engage with cities, institutions, and public life, proving that education and entertainment do not just coexist, they thrive together. A stand-up comedian, LizaBanks has applied her comedic instincts to an unexpected arena, tourism and cultural education. As a New York City tour guide leading sold out experiences at The Metropolitan Museum of Art and Grand Central Terminal, she has transformed traditional sightseeing into immersive, personality driven storytelling. Her tours feel less like lectures and more like live performances, attracting audiences who may never have stepped inside a museum otherwise. In the process, she is modernizing tourism for a social first generation and demonstrating how creators can bring legacy institutions into the digital age. Online, LizaBanks extends that same sensibility through content that blends humor, historical context, and sharp social observation. In 2025, she expanded her platform into civic conversation, interviewing political figures including Zohran Mamdani and engaging audiences around issues like public transit and accessibility with clarity and curiosity. She frequently collaborates with Overheard, including hosting its Happy Hour series, and facilitating red carpet interviews. Last year, LizaBanks was profiled in The Cut and appeared on The Today Show with Al Roker, signaling her crossover from digital creator to broader cultural figure. - 2 premium seats - $90 food & beverage credit ($45 per person) - Gratuity - Ticket Protection Management reserves the right to prevent customers from entering the facility who they deem disruptive or dangerous to other patrons. events.summary: Presenting in Portland at Can Can's Paris Theatre ⭐ Can Can, the award-winning dance theatre company, presents Twas the Night Before Nutcracker for the grand reopening of the historic Paris Theatre! A holiday classic flipped upside down, this sparkling spectacle blends classic, modern, aerial, and burlesque performances with Can Can’s refined cabaret style. Description Step into a holiday where tradition is turned upside down and inside out. ’Twas the Night Before Nutcracker is a glittering, whimsical journey through Clara’s holiday eve. What begins with a lively soirée and an innocent absinthe toast unravels into a dreamscape of marching soldiers, mischievous mice, swirling snowflakes, and sugarplum visions dancing about. Set to Can Can’s original adaptation of the iconic Nutcracker score, the show features new original songs alongside beloved holiday classics, a festive script, magical choreography, and stunning visuals. The spectacle weaves together classic, modern, aerial, and burlesque performances with Can Can’s refined cabaret style. Sprinkle in the perfect amount of comedy, and a touch of theatrical spark, and you’ve got a show as enchanting as it is unexpected. With its blend of elegance, humor, high kicks, and holiday spirit, ‘Twas the Night Before Nutcracker is a new holiday tradition in the making. Baz Moto's 'wildly entertaining' frontwoman Bronwyn (Vinstar7 Radio) dances through the crowd, inspiring you to sing, clap, and jump along: come do the Time Warp, grab a tambourine, or get down in their limbo contest! One of the founding members of Baz Moto, Blake Sakamoto, was the keyboardist in the Dan Reed Network (Mercury/Polygram Records), the funk rock band from Portland. Two other band members, Camille Denny (drums) and Annelise Josserand (bass), were in Erotic City and Madam Torment. Guitarist Brandon Navia is from My Siamese Twin. It started in the late 90s, when he first heard 'Midnight Moonlight' from Old and In the Way. That moment forever bonded Josh to bluegrass music. He went on to serve as President of the Oregon Bluegrass Association and continues to host 'Music From the True Vine' on KBOO-FM, the longest running bluegrass show West of the Mississippi. Josh has played in dozens of bands, along with running his own hard-driving bluegrass band for nearly two decades. That's why hometown fans have lovingly nicknamed him 'The Elvis of Portland Bluegrass.' The Lauries are an alternative-indie band from Hillsboro Oregon. They seamlessly mix Latin and English sounds to create a memorable, inclusive, and emotion provoking performance. Their set includes a mixture of powerful and soft ballads, giving something for everyone to enjoy. The band primarily stays in the Portland Metro area, playing at local markets and charity events, but has also made appearances as special guests at venues such as the New Tampa Theater in Florida and at the McMenamins Crystal ballroom in Portland Oregon. As an all-woman band, they pour their identity into their music to share their perspectives and teach the listeners. It is their mission to encourage young audiences to pursue their interests in music.

events.summary: Wyrd War proudly presents the Pacific Northwest theatrical premiere of cult filmmaker Nico B’s intimate and unflinching homage to the life, death and creative legacy of Rozz Williams and CHRISTIAN DEATH. Rozz Williams: Romeo's Distress (2026) tracks the shapeshifting artist’s ardent journey from his childhood in a strict Southern Baptist household in Pomona, California through his total immersion in uncompromising artistic expression and the rise of truly seminal bands, including Christian Death, Shadow Project and Premature Ejaculation, to his death by suicide in a West Hollywood apartment on April Fool’s Day at the age of 34. Cult Epics founder Nico B is the steward of the largest Rozz Williams archive in the world, and he taps into a deep wellspring of rare photos, concert footage and candid interviews with former creative partners and surviving family members to explore and enshrine the full scope of his former collaborator’s life work in this exceptional new documentary. One night only! Director: Nico B Format: Digital

An Undying Love For A Burning World is the first new release from Neurosis in a decade, and a potent statement of intent and rebirth - one that marks the first new steps of resolve and resilience. “We need this, perhaps more than ever, and we suspect we are not alone. The trials and tribulations in our personal lives and as a band, combined with simply trying to navigate the insanity of our society, with the stress, anxiety, and isolation that come with it can be excruciating. Add to that the existential confusion and sorrow of the climate crisis and the sixth mass extinction. It is enough to cause you to completely lose your mind if you can’t find release or catharsis. This strange emotionally charged music has always been our method of trying to survive this and this is what we've always been singing about. When you have spent a lifetime engaged with these energies and utilizing this form of expression to purge and purify, it feels detrimental to our well being to let it sit idle and neglected. This was now or never.” An Undying Love For A Burning World is an epic album of colossal hypnotism - beautiful, fearsome and utterly compelling in a way that only Neurosis can be. Aaron Turner (Sumac, Isis) joins the band on vocals and guitar, a name whose legacy is intertwined with the band’s own and a true kindred spirit. “He came straight out of the gate contributing, writing and presenting ideas,” says the band. “His energy matches ours perfectly. It’s as if he was always meant to be there.” Aaron adds, “From the moment I first heard Neurosis over 30 years ago, I felt this was the music my heart and mind had been seeking but not yet heard. Now after many years travelling along various musical paths of my own, the singular sound and spirit embodied by Neurosis continues to speak to the depths of my being. It is an honor and a true pleasure to have been welcomed so warmly into a band that not only shaped my perspective on the limitless possibilities of music - but has lived and exemplified the necessity of upholding creative integrity and camaraderie above all else.” Neurosis have never been afraid of change, and here they embrace endless regeneration, surrendering to the emotional exorcism through heaviness and distortion that their music incites. Just as the universe tends towards balance, Neurosis’cacophony of noise, rhythm and dissonance always resolves towards moments of beauty. The addition of Turner's powerful vocals and wildly creative and unhinged approach to guitar proves to be a vital force as Neurosis find themselves again at the mercy of evolution and expression. The album was recorded by Scott Evans (Kowloon Walled City, Sumac, and Great Falls) at Studio Litho in Seattle during three weekends this winter, and mixed in three days just six weeks before release at Evan's Antisleep Audio in Oakland. events.summary: Speed Dating Tonight! Music & Libretto by Michael Ching Based on a concept by Dean Anthony Portland State University’s Opera program kicks off its 50th anniversary season with Michael Ching’s “Speed Dating Tonight!” (2013). Set over the course of a single evening at a local bar, this clever, heartwarming opera follows a revolving cast of singles searching for that elusive spark. There's the dreamer, the hopeless romantic, the bashful, the over-sharer, the chronically distracted, and everyone in between, each getting their moment in the spotlight through music that is equal parts tender, heartbreaking, and hilarious. Written with duets and ensembles for up to 45 voices, “Speed Dating Tonight!” has a flexible modular structure that can be customized to fit any cast size, voice type, or gender identity. PSU Opera’s version of “Speed Dating Tonight!” features 35 song selections and arrangements specifically chosen to reflect the unique assortment of voices in the 12-member cast. At its heart, this is a show about the universal human longing to be seen and cherished by another person. Woven through the interactions is another question: can a genuine connection actually happen in five minutes or less? With Michael Ching’s delightful opera, the answer is decidedly yes. Visit the Speed Dating Tonight! web page to learn more about this production, including additional dates, cast and crew information, photos, and more as we get closer to opening night. Learn more about the Opera program at Portland State University's School of Music & Theater.
events.title: PSU Opera presents: Speed Dating Tonight!

Curious Comedy Showdown is a Portland favorite for first dates and date nights, birthday parties, bachelorette parties, company events, team bonding, and girls-night-out! Without a doubt, this show is one of the most fun and unique things to do in Portland. Delicious food. Full bar. Big laughs. In a word? Joy.

events.summary: Rhys Darby is an actor, writer, podcaster and stand-up comedian from New Zealand. Darby first captured US audiences as Murray, the loveable, but ultimately inept manager in HBO’s Flight of the Conchords. He has gone on to star in a plethora of TV and film roles, from Yes Man and Pirate Radio (The Boat that Rocked) to Nigel in the Jumanji reboots. On the small screen he has brought his talents to animations like Voltron Legendary Defender and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, and shows like TBS’ Wrecked, The X Files and Lemony Snicket. Most recently he starred as the gentleman pirate, Stede Bonnet in Our Flag Means Death. Darby is never far from his stand-up roots. His stand-up has been described as a sensational blend of sound effects, characterizations and askew observations. Rhys has five stand-up specials’, Imagine That! (2008), It’s Rhys Darby Night! (2011) and This Way to Spaceship, (2012) and I’m a Fighter Jet (2017) and Mystic Time Bird (2021). This Way to Spaceship was based on his debut novel of the same name, “A loosely autobiographical end of world companion” in 2012. It was number 1 in the international charts for 7 weeks. Darby’s second book, this time for kids, was released in Australia and New Zealand in October 2018. It is called The Top Secret Notes of Buttons McGinty. Darby wrote it for his then 8-year-old son, a reluctant reader, and has been thrilled to hear from kids and parents that they love it! He went on to release another two Buttons books, which thrilled his legions of junior fans. Rhys’ love of the weird is seen in his stand-up and writing, and for ten years he has had first a radio show, then a podcast on cryptozoology, The Cryptid Factor. Darby was thrilled when approached by Spotify to do a podcast about aliens, Aliens like Us. A regular attendee of alien conferences and stargazer, it was a dream come true. A prolific voice-over artist, kids all over the world hear him in Voltron: Legendary defender, Spirit, TMNT, Boss Baby, Jake and the Neverland Pirates and many more. He also lends his voice to animated films like Trolls, Teen Titans Go, 100% Wolf and Mosley. Darby is excited to lend his voice to the upcoming film That Christmas and the classic story, Badjelly the Witch. In between his huge adventures Darby is based in Los Angeles with his family where they like to hike, eat tacos and explore the world. events.summary: LizaBanks Campagna is building an entirely new lane in the creator economy, one where comedy, culture, and civic curiosity collide. In 2025, she emerged as one of the most original voices reshaping how audiences engage with cities, institutions, and public life, proving that education and entertainment do not just coexist, they thrive together. A stand-up comedian, LizaBanks has applied her comedic instincts to an unexpected arena, tourism and cultural education. As a New York City tour guide leading sold out experiences at The Metropolitan Museum of Art and Grand Central Terminal, she has transformed traditional sightseeing into immersive, personality driven storytelling. Her tours feel less like lectures and more like live performances, attracting audiences who may never have stepped inside a museum otherwise. In the process, she is modernizing tourism for a social first generation and demonstrating how creators can bring legacy institutions into the digital age. Online, LizaBanks extends that same sensibility through content that blends humor, historical context, and sharp social observation. In 2025, she expanded her platform into civic conversation, interviewing political figures including Zohran Mamdani and engaging audiences around issues like public transit and accessibility with clarity and curiosity. events.summary: Speed Dating Tonight! Music & Libretto by Michael Ching Based on a concept by Dean Anthony Portland State University’s Opera program kicks off its 50th anniversary season with Michael Ching’s “Speed Dating Tonight!” (2013). Set over the course of a single evening at a local bar, this clever, heartwarming opera follows a revolving cast of singles searching for that elusive spark. There's the dreamer, the hopeless romantic, the bashful, the over-sharer, the chronically distracted, and everyone in between, each getting their moment in the spotlight through music that is equal parts tender, heartbreaking, and hilarious. Written with duets and ensembles for up to 45 voices, “Speed Dating Tonight!” has a flexible modular structure that can be customized to fit any cast size, voice type, or gender identity. PSU Opera’s version of “Speed Dating Tonight!” features 35 song selections and arrangements specifically chosen to reflect the unique assortment of voices in the 12-member cast. At its heart, this is a show about the universal human longing to be seen and cherished by another person. Woven through the interactions is another question: can a genuine connection actually happen in five minutes or less? With Michael Ching’s delightful opera, the answer is decidedly yes. Visit the Speed Dating Tonight! web page to learn more about this production, including additional dates, cast and crew information, photos, and more as we get closer to opening night. Learn more about the Opera program at Portland State University's School of Music & Theater.

events.summary: Rhys Darby is an actor, writer, podcaster and stand-up comedian from New Zealand. Darby first captured US audiences as Murray, the loveable, but ultimately inept manager in HBO’s Flight of the Conchords. He has gone on to star in a plethora of TV and film roles, from Yes Man and Pirate Radio (The Boat that Rocked) to Nigel in the Jumanji reboots. On the small screen he has brought his talents to animations like Voltron Legendary Defender and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, and shows like TBS’ Wrecked, The X Files and Lemony Snicket. Most recently he starred as the gentleman pirate, Stede Bonnet in Our Flag Means Death. Darby is never far from his stand-up roots. His stand-up has been described as a sensational blend of sound effects, characterizations and askew observations. Rhys has five stand-up specials’, Imagine That! (2008), It’s Rhys Darby Night! (2011) and This Way to Spaceship, (2012) and I’m a Fighter Jet (2017) and Mystic Time Bird (2021). This Way to Spaceship was based on his debut novel of the same name, “A loosely autobiographical end of world companion” in 2012. It was number 1 in the international charts for 7 weeks. Darby’s second book, this time for kids, was released in Australia and New Zealand in October 2018. It is called The Top Secret Notes of Buttons McGinty. Darby wrote it for his then 8-year-old son, a reluctant reader, and has been thrilled to hear from kids and parents that they love it! He went on to release another two Buttons books, which thrilled his legions of junior fans. Rhys’ love of the weird is seen in his stand-up and writing, and for ten years he has had first a radio show, then a podcast on cryptozoology, The Cryptid Factor. Darby was thrilled when approached by Spotify to do a podcast about aliens, Aliens like Us. A regular attendee of alien conferences and stargazer, it was a dream come true. A prolific voice-over artist, kids all over the world hear him in Voltron: Legendary defender, Spirit, TMNT, Boss Baby, Jake and the Neverland Pirates and many more. He also lends his voice to animated films like Trolls, Teen Titans Go, 100% Wolf and Mosley. Darby is excited to lend his voice to the upcoming film That Christmas and the classic story, Badjelly the Witch. In between his huge adventures Darby is based in Los Angeles with his family where they like to hike, eat tacos and explore the world. events.summary: LizaBanks Campagna is building an entirely new lane in the creator economy, one where comedy, culture, and civic curiosity collide. In 2025, she emerged as one of the most original voices reshaping how audiences engage with cities, institutions, and public life, proving that education and entertainment do not just coexist, they thrive together. A stand-up comedian, LizaBanks has applied her comedic instincts to an unexpected arena, tourism and cultural education. As a New York City tour guide leading sold out experiences at The Metropolitan Museum of Art and Grand Central Terminal, she has transformed traditional sightseeing into immersive, personality driven storytelling. Her tours feel less like lectures and more like live performances, attracting audiences who may never have stepped inside a museum otherwise. In the process, she is modernizing tourism for a social first generation and demonstrating how creators can bring legacy institutions into the digital age. Online, LizaBanks extends that same sensibility through content that blends humor, historical context, and sharp social observation. In 2025, she expanded her platform into civic conversation, interviewing political figures including Zohran Mamdani and engaging audiences around issues like public transit and accessibility with clarity and curiosity. She frequently collaborates with Overheard, including hosting its Happy Hour series, and facilitating red carpet interviews. Last year, LizaBanks was profiled in The Cut and appeared on The Today Show with Al Roker, signaling her crossover from digital creator to broader cultural figure. - 2 premium seats - $90 food & beverage credit ($45 per person) - Gratuity - Ticket Protection Management reserves the right to prevent customers from entering the facility who they deem disruptive or dangerous to other patrons. events.summary: Jalen Ngonda honours soul music’s rich history while pushing it forward into new territory, an artist who’s both archivist and explorer, a disciple of the greats actively shaping the future of music. Having spent the last three years growing this new soul vision from small clubs to arenas and festivals across the world Ngonda stands poised to become the new spokesman of authentic soul with the release of his second album Doctrine Of Love. Doctrine Of Love is an instant classic of an album, a long player alive with a confidence and swagger that seals the young singer’s reputation as not only the spiritual heir of soul’s great leading men but a one-off songwriting talent stepping far out from the shadows of his artistic ancestors. The title track ‘Doctrine Of Love’ sets both the emotional tone and musical template for the rest of the album, “I wrote that track when I was trying to do anything to get out of the studio” remembers Ngonda. “I was listening to a lot of James Brown at the time and that was an inspiration – Doctrine to me was a word no-one ever uses, I took it to be like a certificate, the ‘Certificate of Love’ – look, I think maybe I meant ‘doctorate’, but we wrote it and recorded it and now it’s a whole thing.” The Doctrine of Love is multi-faceted of course – yes, it can be a cool word that fits the song, it can be a code, a philosophy, words to live by, words to love by, words to write some classic music by. ““I just write the song,” Ngonda enthuses, “the listener can interpret it however they want.”
events.title: Jalen Ngonda: Doctrine of Love Tour

events.summary: Guitarist, composer and producer Chance Hayden presents the Desert Room All Stars, a monthly series every Last Sunday at McMenamins, Al's Den evoking the venue's storied past in the 50s and 60s as the Desert Room. Formerly a high-class hang for Portland's underworld where anything desired was obtainable, burlesque and jazz were showcased nightly with a long-term house band led by New Orleans native saxophonist Charlie Gabriel who attracted notable guests such as Duke Ellington, Cab Calloway and Sammy Davis Jr. In a similar format, Hayden leads a trio plus various guests performing two sets of mid-century jazz, blues and original works inspired by that period. Hayden's guitar stylings are rooted deeply at the intersection of these genres, yielding an "adventurous, no-holds-barred sensibility with both bluesy grit and modern-jazz finesse" (Jazz Society Of Oregon). Though the building has undergone numerous changes through the years and be come more of a singer-songwriter hub under McMenamins ownership, vibes of the Desert Room era remain highly palpable and Hayden will reveal that Al's Den stands as one of one of the city's most iconic rooms for jazz.
events.title: Chance Hayden's Desert Room All Stars, Gina Saputo

events.summary: Jake Shimabukuro is a world-renowned ukulele virtuoso whose groundbreaking artistry has redefined the instrument for the 21st century. Hailed as the “Jimi Hendrix of the ukulele,” Shimabukuro has captivated audiences across the globe with his masterful technique, innovative spirit, and deeply expressive performances that seamlessly blend elements of jazz, rock, classical, blues, folk, and traditional Hawaiian music. Born and raised in Honolulu, Hawai‘i, Jake began playing the ukulele at age four, quickly developing a unique style that pushed the instrument far beyond its traditional boundaries. He first gained international recognition after his jaw-dropping rendition of George Harrison’s “While My Guitar Gently Weeps” went viral, introducing millions to the ukulele’s untapped potential. Over the course of his career, Shimabukuro has released numerous acclaimed albums, collaborated with an array of legendary artists—including Bette Midler, Yo-Yo Ma, Jimmy Buffett, Ziggy Marley, and Mick Fleetwood—and performed everywhere from the Sydney Opera House to the Hollywood Bowl and the Kennedy Center. His most recent projects showcase both his dazzling technical command and his growing focus on emotional storytelling through music. Beyond the stage, Jake is a passionate advocate for music education and community outreach, frequently performing at schools and benefit concerts to inspire the next generation of musicians. Whether playing an intimate solo show or headlining with a full band, Shimabukuro continues to prove that the ukulele is an instrument of infinite possibilities—one that speaks a universal language of joy, connection, and hope.
events.title: Jake Shimabukuro: Holidays in Hawaiʻi

events.summary: Crater Lake National Park was signed into law by President Theodore Roosevelt in 1902. It was the fifth of over sixty national parks in the United States. In commemoration of Oregon's only national park, the Oregon Historical Society (OHS) has created a new exhibit, Creating a Masterpiece: Artists and the Origins of Crater Lake National Park (on view from November 20, 2026 to January 9, 2028) and published the Oregon Historical Quarterly 's Fall 2026 special issue, entitled "Crater Lake and Artistic Imagination." Professor Peter Boag and OHS curator Megan Lallier-Barron tell the story of how 19th-century landscape painters brought Crater Lake to regional and national audiences and influenced its national park designation. They share the inspiration and research behind the exhibition and discuss how - through everything from historic paintings and photographs to museum objects and QR codes - they have made the story available to a modern audience.
events.title: Bringing Light and Color to Crater Lake

events.summary: Neuroscience, Art & Culture in Chile What can art teach us about the brain, memory, and resilience? Join this interdisciplinary faculty-led program in Valparaíso and Viña del Mar, Chile, and explore the connections between neuroscience, art, memory, and culture. Students will visit neuroscience labs, museums, galleries, and cultural sites while learning from local researchers and artists. Through hands-on experiences, students will explore topics including sensation and perception, memory, trauma, stress, and resilience, while creating art journals and traditional Chilean arpilleras. Led by PSU faculty Bill Griesar and Jeff Leake, this program is open to students from all majors and is especially suited for those interested in neuroscience, psychology, biology, art, education, public health, and the humanities. events.summary: Dec 1 | 7-9 pm | Doors at 6 The River Remembers: Community, Science, and the Future of Portland Harbor with Cassie Cohen, Executive Director, Portland Harbor Community Coalition and Ja’Marian Malley, Campaign Manager, Portland Harbor Community Coalition About the Lecture Portland’s working river carries many stories — of industry, contamination, community, survival, restoration, and responsibility. The Portland Harbor Superfund cleanup is not only a technical process; it is also a public health, environmental justice, and accountability issue that will shape the future of the Willamette River for generations. In this talk, Portland Harbor Community Coalition will help audiences understand what is at stake in the cleanup, how decisions about contaminated sediment, restoration, disposal, access, and habitat affect people and place, and why community and Tribal voices must be centered in decisions about the river’s future. Through images, stories, and practical examples, this presentation will invite people to ask: Who speaks for the river — and how do we listen? Science Pubs are a casual lecture series located in fun venues across the region, recommended for ages 10 and over. Tickets $8 suggested donation | Advance tickets recommended Zoom Option If you are unable to join us in person, you can watch on Zoom. You must register in advance. After registering, you will receive a confirmation email containing information about joining the meeting. About the Speakers Cassie Cohen serves as Executive Director of Portland Harbor Community Coalition, a community-based organization working to advance environmental justice, public health, community education, and accountability in the Portland Harbor Superfund cleanup. Through PHCC, Cassie works alongside community members, advocates, technical experts, public agencies, and partners to ensure that cleanup decisions are understandable, transparent, and responsive to the people and places most impacted by pollution along the Willamette River.
events.title: Science Pub: Portland Harbor

events.summary: Portland’s longest running improv jam, Open Court is beloved, fun, supportive, and open to all! What happens when improvisers of all levels of skill and experience, from all different theaters and troupes, from Portland and beyond, come together to perform long-form improv comedy for each other and the audience? FUN! Everyone is welcome to play in Open Court whether you have been playing for years or have never been on a stage before in your life. events.summary: Please note, when selecting the Print at Home or Mobile Delivery method, you will not have access to view your tickets until 14 days prior to the performance How to honor the legacy of a band deemed sacred? To tread on holy ground is perilous, and must be done with the intent and spirit of a disciple—Pay attention to the intricacies of the magic, explore the far ends of the innovation, strive for ever-growing ability, and let the purity of the love for the music drive it all. Drummer Clementine is the founding member of ZEPPARELLA. From the beginning of her musical career, her goal has been to be onstage every night. The pursuit of that goal has led Clementine to constantly tour the US and Europe in projects as diverse as Bottom, AC/DShe, The House Of More, The Solid, Francis Bakin, Stars Turn Me On and Beaux Cheveux. She tackles the best rock drumming ever written with her own emotionally powerful style, bringing the Motown influence of the Bonham groove to the forefront. The profound musical connection established with Gretchen Menn (guitar), Holly West (bass), and Anna Kristina (vocals) creates the bond required to do this great music justice. It was under the tutelage of classical guitarist Phillip DeFremery, a student of Andrés Segovia, that guitarist Gretchen Menn began her path on the instrument. Playing with tireless passion and constantly seeking out new challenges, her projects are often unconventional, genre-bending expressions combining elements of classical, rock, progressive, jazz, and metal. On influences, Gretchen has never tired of her initial inspirations—Eric Johnson, Steve Morse, Frank Zappa, and Jeff Beck. But she has loved Jimmy Page’s guitar playing longer than she has played the guitar. It was through the music of Led Zeppelin that she found a gateway into music that resonated deeply with her, creating a love for guitar-oriented music, and, ultimately, the guitar. Bassist Holly West began her musical journey full-steam ahead, and more recently than her stellar playing belies. Her unstoppable will and drive have truly propelled her to this moment and her place in the powerhouse Zepparella. A self-taught bass player, she is also a blossoming vocalist with rich rock pipes. Her time on stage has been well spent, developing an impressive attack, impeccable feel, and a technique which seems to have come completely naturally to her, not to mention her dazzling stage presence and joyful performance style. Her influences span the rock gauntlet, from Clutch and the Rival Sons to Slash, ZZ Top, and of course, the mighty Zeppelin. Singer Anna Kristina is a soulful, fiery, and rocking vocal powerhouse who has stepped into Zepparella’s Plant spot for a second time. Anna was with the band for 5 years, became known for her performance in the band’s 15 million-view “When The Levee Breaks” video, took a 6-year hiatus, and now returns in 2018 to front the band. Her career has spanned acoustic, jazz, soul, rock, and her charisma and power delivers captivating performances every night. About her brilliant harp playing she says: “getting a chance to blow on the harmonica is an added bonus! Plant isn’t just a singer he’s a musician. He brings his blues background and natural percussive feel to his harmonica playing as well and I love getting lost in that. Playing the harp allows me to express on a whole different level and it’s so freeing.” Now more than ever, Zepparella explores their own improvised magic within the framework of Zeppelin’s mighty songs! This Event is All Ages and General Admission. ALL SALES ARE FINAL. PLEASE, DOUBLE CHECK YOUR ORDER BEFORE PURCHASING. NO REFUNDS.

events.summary: https://marleyhale.com/ With a beguiling voice that would feel right at home on classic country radio, Marley Hale delivers a captivating country/folk sound rooted in the refined yet adventurous musicality she’s cultivated almost her entire life. As revealed on her debut EP, By My Own Ways, to be released July 26, 2024, the Brooklyn-based singer/songwriter matches her timeless sensibilities and graceful musicianship with a one-of-a-kind narrative voice, endlessly merging raw truth with mesmerizing storytelling. Born in Austin but raised in Northern California, Hale first learned to play guitar from her father at age 10 and soon began writing songs of her own. Although she grew up listening to classic-rock bands like Led Zeppelin and pop visionaries like Kate Bush and David Bowie, she later became fascinated with folk luminaries such as Karen Dalton and Bob Dylan and eventually discovered the artists she now lists among her essential touchstones, including Loretta Lynn and Gillian Welch. https://www.thejustclark.band/ Clark Engine Company is the full band manifestation of frequent-favorite, Just Clark, a singer-songwriter reviving the roots of American-made music. Digging into a woody sound that echoes through the hollers, Clark’s music embodies a timeless resonance that harks back to the cherished sounds of classic Americana folk. From poet to picker, the native Texan conjures a sound as bright as the Lonestar herself. Being more than the stand alone folk type, Clark Engine Company is an electrifying extension that goes beyond a guitar and a pretty voice. With weeping pedal steel and crashing drums it’s full steam ahead for the full band. Always on the move, Clark is a true troubadour who’s lust for the open road is never ending.

events.summary: A whole new story. A bigger cast of characters. And even MORE ways for everything to go spectacularly wrong! Last December, our audience screamed with delight as their choices shaped a ridiculous, sexy, utterly unpredictable adventure through a post-apocalyptic world left in ashes by a scorned witch. It was such a blast that we decided to make Choose Your Own Adventure an annual LEWDicrous tradition! That's right – we're back for Volume 2, and we're writing a whole new chapter of deliciously debaucherous mayhem! Join us for another burlesque and drag odyssey where YOU decide what happens next! Will you choose danger or desire, comedy or chaos? Every twist, every turn, every tassel is up to you. You are the hero of this story. Or the villain. Or maybe just a tipsy bystander yelling, "Hubba Hubba!" Presiding over the madness is our feverishly inspired, questionably stable narrator, Victor Von Dextrous, who will guide you through a story so absurd, so seductive, and so spectacularly unpredictable that even the performers won't know where it's headed. Do you open the door to glitter and glory? Turn to page 43. Do you descend into the dungeon of debauchery? Turn to page 69. (Of course.) This year, we're going bigger and better, with MORE acts, MORE choices, and an almost entirely new cast of characters. A few familiar faces will return, but the story is completely new! Your decisions will shape the narrative and determine when acts take the stage. Together, we'll make up a delightfully deranged, beautifully bizarre adventure as we go – and everyone gets to be part of the fun! Featuring solo performances by: Nick Lacy Dria Dore Ry Bread Luna DeLyte Rob Thee 2nd Zepheur Amber Dextrous Anna Nymph PLUS: A special group performance by the fabulous trio Rebelle Rouge! AND: For the first time ever, our signature Improv Roulette is going GROUP! The fabulous troublemakers of burlesque troupe SassHole will take on an improv challenge live onstage, bringing our story to its thrilling conclusion -- as chosen by YOU, the audience! What song will they dance to? What will happen? Your guess is as good as ours! (Or theirs, for that matter -- even they won't know until you choose how the story ends!) We're thrilled to bring this year's adventure to Hōkū Events, a fully accessible venue, with ASL interpretation made possible through grant support from the Regional Arts & Culture Council (RACC). One night. Countless possibilities. Absolutely no good decisions guaranteed. You make the choices. We make them silly and sexy. Friday, December 4, 2026 | Hōkū Events | Portland, OR LEWDicrous is funded in part by the Regional Arts & Culture Council and the Office of Arts & Culture.
events.title: LEWDicrous: Choose Your Own Adventure (Vol. 2)

events.summary: Chris Grace and Ross Bryant are simultaneously the smartest and the silliest two-man improv show you'll ever see. Chris Grace and Ross Bryant bring their decades of comedy experience together to create a singular improv event that’s simultaneously super smart and wildly dumb. Combining intelligence, wit, and an encyclopedic knowledge of the world with the ever-present danger of saying or doing something profoundly silly, Chris and Ross present a fully-improvised show that’s both highbrow and lowbrow at the same time. They’ll take a single suggestion and spin it into an hourlong deep-dive into scenes like: two priests naming parts of church architecture to try to determine which of them is a fake, or a pair of scientists working on the Hubble Telescope that can’t figure out how a doorknob works. It’s improv at its best: intricate, playful, surprising, and stupid in all the right ways. Come watch two of the sharpest comedic minds turn a single audience suggestion into a full-length, never-before-seen, and never-to-be-seen-again comedic journey. THE PERFORMERS Chris Grace and Ross Bryant have played together for years with seminal musical improv group Baby Wants Candy, and have combined forces on Dropout’s "Make Some Noise". Ross has been a longtime member of the Improvised Shakespeare Company and Chris, best known for playing Jerry on "Superstore" and Duane on "The Residence", recently released his solo comedy special "Chris Grace: As Scarlett Johansson" on Dropout.
events.title: Grace & Bryant
